ei.title: Chapter 5-15: Carbohydrates: The Body's Primary Fuel
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: Carbohydrates are the most important source of energy in a balanced daily diet. Carbohydrate intake must be balanced with adequate amounts of protein, fat, and water intake. In athletes, carbohydrates are the primary fuel source to maintain blood glucose for energy during exercise. Adequate carbohydrate intake also helps spare muscle from catabolic activity and muscle breakdown. After carbohydrates are consumed, they are broken down into smaller sugars that get absorbed and used as energy. The body is capable of storing excess carbohydrates in the form of glycogen in the muscles and liver. The body's glycogen capacity is approximately 300 to 400 grams. Subsequent excesses are then converted to fat and stored. Conversely, in the setting of inadequate intake, an energy imbalance can result in adverse effects on athletic performance as well as overall health.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 가장 중요한 에너지원, 적절한 양, 근육을 보호한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① important — adequate — spare — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② trivial (A 반대: 중요한→사소한)
❌ ③ insufficient (B 반대: 적절한→불충분한)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 탄수화물 섭취는 단백질·지방·수분의 적절한 양(adequate)과 균형을 이뤄야 하므로 excessive(과도한)는 부적절.
det.analysis:
① <u>important</u> (중요한) — 가장 중요한 에너지원, 적절

② <u>excessive amounts</u> (과도한 양) — 원문 adequate amounts(적절한 양). 균형 잡힌 섭취 맥락에서 excessive 부적절 ←정답

③ <u>maintain</u> (유지하다) — 혈당을 유지, 적절

④ <u>storing</u> (저장하는) — 잉여 탄수화물을 저장, 적절

The body is capable of storing ③<u>insufficient carbohydrates</u> in the form of glycogen in the muscles and liver. The body's glycogen capacity is approximately 300 to 400 grams. Subsequent excesses are then ④<u>converted</u> to fat and stored. Conversely, in the setting of inadequate intake, an energy imbalance can result in adverse effects on athletic performance as well as overall health.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 인체는 잉여(excess) 탄수화물을 글리코겐으로 저장하므로 insufficient(불충분한)는 부적절.
det.analysis:
① <u>primary</u> (주요한) — 주요 연료원, 적절

② <u>absorbed</u> (흡수되는) — 더 작은 당분으로 분해되어 흡수, 적절

③ <u>insufficient carbohydrates</u> (불충분한 탄수화물) — 원문 excess(잉여). 인체는 남는 탄수화물을 저장하므로 insufficient 부적절 ←정답

④ <u>converted</u> (전환되는) — 지방으로 전환, 적절

The body is capable of storing excess carbohydrates in the form of glycogen in the muscles and liver. The body's glycogen ③<u>capacity</u> is approximately 300 to 400 grams. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 운동 중 에너지를 위해 혈당을 유지(maintain)하는 것이므로 lower(낮추다)는 부적절.
det.analysis:
① <u>lower</u> (낮추다) — 원문 maintain(유지하다). 운동 중 에너지를 위해 혈당을 유지하는 맥락에서 lower 부적절 ←정답

② <u>consumed</u> (섭취된) — 탄수화물이 섭취된 후, 적절

③ <u>capacity</u> (수용량) — 글리코겐 수용량, 적절

④ <u>adverse</u> (부정적인) — 부정적 영향, 적절
